content:
Aisha M. (Finance): Heads up - CFO wants recommended vendor for the invoice reconciliation RFP. Shortlist: LedgerIQ, ParseFlow, ReconcileX. Need a final 12-month TCO + pilot credit comparison by Mon noon.
Ravi K. (Procurement): I'll gather list/negotiated pricing. Quick asks: pilot length & cost, min commit, termination fees.
Nick (ParseFlow Sales): ParseFlow can do a 60-day pilot at $2k/mo list (we can discount to $1k/mo). No long-term commit required but enterprise plans have a 6mo onboarding minimum.
Lina S. (SRE): SRE checklist: ingestion methods (Kafka/SFTP/API), data residency options, retention defaults. Also need estimated eng effort for connector setup.
vendor-bot: "ParseFlow docs: https://parseflow.example/docs; LedgerIQ SOC2: https://ledgeriq.example/soc2"
Diego P. (Legal): flagging ParseFlow indemnity cap at $500k. Need redline before pilot-to-prod.
Aisha M. (Finance): include amortized migration (we estimate $15k) and manual fallback ops cost. Also model storage overage if retention > included days.
Ravi K. (Procurement): LedgerIQ replied: 90-day pilot, $0 pilot fee if we sign MSA within 45 days. ReconcileX: 30-day free trial but requires DB connector work.
Lina S. (SRE): connector delta: LedgerIQ = 2 engineer-days (Kafka + mapping), ParseFlow = 8 engineer-days (custom mapping UI), ReconcileX = 10 engineer-days (DB connector + validation).
Aisha M. (Finance): good. For scoring I'll use Cost 45%, Integration 20%, Features 20%, Legal/Risk 15%. Any objections?
Diego P. (Legal): fine. I'll review indemnities and data clauses. Ask vendors for subprocessor lists and DPAs.
Ravi K. (Procurement): I'll request pilot credits from ParseFlow and confirm LedgerIQ MSA timing. Also will push ReconcileX for a commit-free clause.
Nick (ParseFlow Sales): happy to send sample invoice set after NDA; we can also provide accuracy report on 500 invoices.
Aisha M. (Finance): timeline: procurement fills pricing, SRE fills integration effort, legal flags redlines. I'll assemble the memo and post draft here by Sun evening.
Lina S. (SRE): one more: retention - ParseFlow charges $0.025/GB/mo beyond 90 days; LedgerIQ includes 180 days. Add to TCO.
Aisha M. (Finance): noted. Thanks all - please drop numbers into the shared sheet (link in DM) so I can compute weighted scores. I'll @channel when exec snapshot is ready.
